# `aitbc explorer top-addresses`

List the top addresses by balance on a chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer top-addresses [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `20` | no | Number of addresses to return |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer top-addresses
```
